description: List the distinct values, with record counts, that the Georgian (country) heritage register actually uses for a field — region, municipality, settlement, category, status, classification, physical_state, current_function, world_category or period. This is the discovery step for a register written entirely in Georgian script: read the exact stored value here, then pass it to georgia_heritage_search.

field.description: One of: region, municipality, settlement, category, status, classification, physical_state, current_function, world_category, period.

limit.description: Max distinct values, 1-500 (default 50), most frequent first.

municipality.description: Optional: restrict the facet to one municipality (Georgian or English).

region.description: Optional: restrict the facet to one region (Georgian or English).

name: georgia_heritage_facets
title: Georgia Heritage Facets
